* {{ill|Okagami Shrine (Kawasaki City)|ja|岡上神社 (川崎市)}} (おかがみじんじゃ) - A Shinto shrine located at 809 Okagami, {{ill|Asao-ku, Kawasaki|en|Asao-ku, Kawasaki|qid=Q1041779|lt=Asao Ward}}, {{ill|Kawasaki, Kanagawa|en|Kawasaki, Kanagawa|qid=Q164234|lt=Kawasaki City}}, {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|en|Kanagawa Prefecture|qid=Q127513|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture}}.<ref>[https://www.kanagawa-jinja.or.jp/search_dtl.php4?jid=95&cd=1201095&scd=&npg=0 Okagami Shrine (おかがみじんじゃ)] Kanagawa Prefecture Shrine Association</ref><ref name="Asao Tourism"/>  
** {{ill|Kami|ja|祭神|lt=Deities}}: {{ill|Yamato Takeru|ja|日本武尊|lt=Prince Yamato Takeru|3=ヤマトタケル|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ヤマトタケル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q461258}}, {{ill|Takeminakata|ja|建御名方命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takeminakata-no-Kami|qid=Q9150391|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9150391}}, {{ill|Oyamakui no Kami|en|Oyamakui no Kami|qid=Q10935105|qid=Q10935105|lt=Ōyamakui-no-Kami}}, {{ill|Ukanomitama|ja|倉稲魂命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ウカノミタマ|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3080728}}.<ref name="Asao Tourism"/>  
** In 1909 (Meiji 42), five local shrines in {{ill|Okagami|ja|岡上村|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okagami Village|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11471931}} were merged under the name "Okagami Shrine." The site of the former {{ill|Suwa Shrine|ja|諏訪神社}} in the center of the village was chosen for the new shrine to promote unity among villagers.<ref name="Asao Tourism">[https://asao-kankou.jp/?page_id=1992 Okagami Shrine (おかがみじんじゃ)] Asao Tourism, Kawasaki/Asao Tourism Association, accessed January 6, 2022.</ref> See also {{ill|Okagami|ja|岡上#施設|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okagami#Facilities|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11471928}} and {{ill|Okagami|ja|岡上村#歴史|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/History of Okagami Village|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11471931}}.
* Okagami Shrine (おかがみじんじゃ) - The former name of {{ill|Okanomiya Shrine|ja|岡廼宮神社 (深谷市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okanomiya Shrine (Fukaya City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q119929455}}, located in {{ill|Fukaya, Saitama|en|Fukaya, Saitama|qid=Q734532|lt=Fukaya City}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}}.
